entities.summary: Jonathan Brice Johnson is an American professional basketball player who last played for the Nelson Giants of the New Zealand National Basketball League (NZNBL). He played college basketball for the North Carolina Tar Heels, graduating in 2016. He was selected in the first round by the Los Angeles Clippers in the 2016 NBA draft.
